question: How can I embed a YouTube video in my Fern documentation?
ground_truth: To embed a YouTube video in Fern documentation, use an iframe element with camelCase attributes since .mdx files use JSX syntax. For example: <iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/[video-id]" width="100%" height="450px" frameBorder="0" allowFullScreen></iframe>. Note that attributes must be written in camelCase (e.g., allowFullScreen instead of allowfullscreen).

metadata.cited_context:
### Embed YouTube or Loom videos

You can embed videos from YouTube, Loom, Vimeo, and other streaming platforms using an `<iframe>` element.

<Warning>
  `.mdx` files use JSX syntax, not pure HTML. Attributes for HTML elements like `<video>` and `<iframe>` that are embedded in `.mdx` pages must be written in `camelCase` rather than lowercase. For example, use `autoPlay` instead of `autoplay`.
</Warning>
